scope: One existing shared server helper; no role-specific exemption or permission expansion. Existing endpoint uses the same helper for every authorized document editor. Demo does not perform live document scans.
behavior: Preparation is spent synchronously before awaiting authority, metadata or file IO; concurrent/later calls cannot download again, including after a lost download reply.
The first pending check pins exactly one revision for pre/post-provider checks. A different or malformed revision permanently stops that continuation without further IO.
A failed authority/source/object/pending check cannot resume after conditions recover. Overlapping checks stop both rather than allowing a racing success.
Current edit/view/non-partner, exact source/object/hash/size checks and same downloaded immutable Blob remain unchanged.
required_next: Implement the reviewed private exact-source/failed-revision claim and both-unit capacity reservation before file IO; retain no-replay handling for lost claim replies.
Prepare a one-use exact-source pending transition before scanner dispatch and its separately source-bound outcome/queue/settlement receipts.
